kept.title: React State Management: When to Use useState, Context, or Zustand
kept.content: Jun 2, 2026 · useState is not a "beginner tool", it's the right tool for local, component-scoped state, at any level of experience. Context API solves prop drilling, not state management. Using it as a global store causes re-render problems that are hard to debug.
